prompts.flower:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: ONE square polished hand-painted game UI icon preview, red flower reward counter, part of a matching flower/trophy/home set.
IMPORTANT NEW ART DIRECTION: SEMI-REALISTIC PICTURE-BOOK ILLUSTRATION (半写实绘本风). Replace the flat thick cartoon outlines with softly modeled naturalistic volumes, rich gentle gouache brushwork, believable soft lighting and tactile painted materials. A delicate hand-painted realism within a warm whimsical children's storybook. NOT flat vector, NOT thick comic outlines, NOT cel shading, NOT glossy plastic or a 3D render. The distinction from the first reference must be clearly visible.
Input images: Image 1 is ONLY structure, numeral placement and frame proportions reference. Do NOT imitate its flat simplified painting style. Image 2 is ONLY context for the storybook map palette and semi-realistic illustrative feel; do NOT copy the map, scene, screenshots or any UI layout.
Composition: one centered ivory rounded-square button plate with thin softly painted sage trim, inset from canvas by about 7% on each side, same-sized margins and generous round corners. Softly tactile paper / ivory plaque surface with minimal warm shading, no hard cast shadow, no text on plate. Background outside the plate genuinely transparent.
Flower: one front-view FIVE PETAL red flower, rounded organic silky petals with subtly curved rims and a little gentle central fold. Warm scarlet to coral petal colors, soft burgundy painted shadows and warm light from upper left. The petals have discernible softly rounded volume and a natural organic feel while remaining simple and clear. NO leaves, NO stem, NO greenery, NO grass. No dots or crowded stamens. Large flower fills about 74% of plate width.
Number field: integrate a roomy pale cream-gold circular center naturally into the flower, about 46% of flower width, smooth quiet central face with a gently painted golden rim. EXACT numeral "9" printed directly in the flower center, bold rounded very dark forest green, flat crisp readable lettering, clear padding. This must remain extremely readable at small game size. No texture, shadow or petal overlaps obscuring the numeral. No separate counter badge or side number. Leave enough central space for future two-digit values.
Cohesive palette: ivory, muted sage, warm forest green, coral scarlet, ochre gold. Refined children's storybook gouache, clean silhouettes and soft painted edges with restrained texture.
Only text: "9". No labels, no words, no extra icons, no watermarks, no sparkle, no glitter, no leaves, no background scene. One icon only.
prompts.trophy:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: ONE standalone square game HUD button illustration preview.
Art direction: semi-realistic picture-book illustration (半写实绘本风), softly modeled believable shapes and warm natural materials painted in rich gentle gouache, delicate visible handmade brushwork, warm upper-left illumination with soft occlusion and no harsh shadows. Whimsical friendly proportions. NOT flat vector, NOT thick dark cartoon strokes, NOT cel-shaded, NOT glossy 3D render, NOT plastic toy.
Input image role: the reference flower button is the EXACT style, palette, paint texture, light direction and frame reference for this coordinated three-icon set. Preserve precisely its ivory rounded-square backing, fine sage-green border, soft paper grain, approximately 7% transparent outer margins, round corners, camera framing, full-bleed size and high finish. Replace ONLY its central flower/numeral artwork with the subject below. Do NOT carry over flower or numeral.
Transparent background outside the button frame. Interior plate stays ivory, quiet, with gentle warm shading. Icon is centered, about 75% of button height/width, leaves clean margins, equally substantial and readable at 56–64px as the source flower. Warm cream, muted sage/forest green, terra-cotta red and gold coordinate with the reference.
Only one finished button, no text anywhere, no numbers, no Chinese, no letters, no labels, no watermarks, no other UI, no sheet, no background scene. Avoid leaves, ribbons, glitter, stars floating around, lens effects, noise, unnecessary decoration or tiny visual clutter.
Subject: one friendly GOLDEN ACHIEVEMENT TROPHY. Rounded substantial golden bowl, broad softly curling symmetrical handles, short stem, simple stable foot. Semi-realistic brushed warm brass/gold painted by hand, believable cup rim thickness, soft amber shaded interior and warm restrained highlights. Clear dimensional volume but no sharp chrome reflection. A single modest ivory five-point star embossed at the center of the cup, no words or number. Keep the silhouette simple: cup, two handles, stem, base. The star can have a subtle warm raised edge. Rich picture-book painting, same brushwork and softly outlined shape edges as the referenced flower petals. No flower, no leaf wreath, no ribbons. Output ONE trophy button.
